/**

 * Description: NON-PRODUCTION full-source seven-chapter Experience 2.0 review.

 * License: Internal review only. Never deploy to a public server.
 */
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) { exit; }
// Fail closed if this MU-plugin is copied outside the disposable, initialized review site.
if (get_option('fv_ex2_playground_review_only', '') !== 'FV_EX2_LOCAL_PLAYGROUND_2026_11_05_V1') { return; }
// Only the disposable Playground page receives these assets. No tracking, CMS sync,
// editor data, subscribers, purchase forms or site-wide theme modifications.
add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', static function () {
    if (!is_page('fv-ex2-review')) { return; }
    wp_register_style('fv-ex2-playground', false, array(), null);
    wp_enqueue_style('fv-ex2-playground');
    wp_add_inline_style('fv-ex2-playground', <<<'FVPG_CSS_END'

/* source: flagship.css */
/* Final Vestige Studios — unpublished Experience 2.0 homepage flagship / three art directions.
   Scoped exclusively under .fv-hf. No remote fonts, libraries, or layout-scrolling overrides. */
:where(.fv-hf){--hf-bg:#0a0a09;--hf-panel:#18140f;--hf-panel2:#221c14;--hf-ink:#f6ebda;--hf-muted:#c3b49f;--hf-gold:#d4ad73;--hf-accent:#c29f68;--hf-line:#4d4330;--hf-blue:#15302e;--hf-serif:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;--hf-sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;--hf-mono:"Courier New",ui-monospace,monospace;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--hf-bg);color:var(--hf-ink);font:400 16px/1.65 var(--hf-sans);width:100%;overflow:clip}
.fv-hf :where(*,*::before,*::after){box-sizing:border-box}
.fv-hf :where(h1,h2,h3,p,figure){margin:0}
.fv-hf :where(a){color:inherit;text-underline-offset:.27em}
.fv-hf :where(button,summary,a){-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.fv-hf :where(button,a,summary):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f6cc86;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:1px}
.fv-hf :where([hidden]){display:none!important}
.fv-hf__canvas{position:relative;background:var(--hf-bg)}
.fv-hf__studio{padding:10px clamp(15px,3vw,50px);background:#c7a66c;color:#12110d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #a28554;font:700 10px/1.5 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.075em}
.fv-hf__masthead{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:35px;padding:24px clamp(20px,5vw,85px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.fv-hf__cairn{display:flex;width:34px;height:34px;position:relative;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(199,166,108,.18))}
.fv-hf__cairn i{display:block;background:var(--hf-gold);height:6px;transform:skew(-12deg);clip-path:polygon(12% 0,85% 8%,100% 70%,85% 100%,7% 85%,0 35%)}.fv-hf__cairn i:nth-child(1){width:16px}.fv-hf__cairn i:nth-child(2){width:24px}.fv-hf__cairn i:nth-child(3){width:32px}
.fv-hf__brand-letter{font-weight:820;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;line-height:1.13}.fv-hf__brand-letter small{display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.34em;color:var(--hf-gold);margin-top:5px}
.fv-hf__nav{display:flex;gap:clamp(15px,2.5vw,36px);margin-left:auto}.fv-hf__nav a{color:var(--hf-muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:640}.fv-hf__nav a:hover,.fv-hf__nav a:focus-visible{color:var(--hf-ink)}
.fv-hf__mast-cta{margin-left:auto;border:1px solid var(--hf-gold);color:var(--hf-gold);padding:9px 15px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:800}.fv-hf__mast-cta:hover{background:var(--hf-gold);color:#090a0a}
.fv-hf__opening{min-height:min(875px,93vh);position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 77% 51%,rgba(142,97,41,.18),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 8% 4%,rgba(25,57,58,.26),transparent 38%),var(--hf-bg);overflow:hidden}
.fv-hf__grain{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.27;pointer-events:none;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.7' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='180' height='180' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.13'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
.fv-hf__halo{position:absolute;z-index:-1;width:58vw;max-width:850px;aspect-ratio:1;right:-15vw;top:3%;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(199,166,108,.11),0 0 0 68px rgba(199,166,108,.012),0 0 0 160px rgba(199,166,108,.009);pointer-events:none}
.fv-hf__opening-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(310px,.7fr);gap:clamp(30px,7vw,135px);align-items:center;width:100%;max-width:1700px;margin:auto;padding:clamp(95px,12vw,185px) clamp(22px,7vw,125px) clamp(75px,8vw,120px)}
.fv-hf__eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:700 10px/1.5 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.13em;color:var(--hf-gold);text-transform:uppercase}.fv-hf__long-rule{width:38px;height:1px;background:var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__issue{margin-left:auto;color:var(--hf-muted);opacity:.78}
.fv-hf__opening h1{font:400 clamp(70px,9.9vw,162px)/.89 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.07em;max-width:1080px;margin:clamp(24px,3vw,45px) 0 clamp(22px,3vw,43px);text-wrap:balance}.fv-hf__opening h1 em{display:block;color:var(--hf-gold);font-weight:400}
.fv-hf__opening-dek{color:#c8c0b4;font:400 clamp(18px,1.65vw,23px)/1.59 var(--hf-sans);max-width:640px}.fv-hf__opening-dek strong{color:var(--hf-ink);font-weight:650}
.fv-hf__opening-actions{display:flex;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:clamp(24px,3vw,45px)}
.fv-hf__button{display:inline-flex;gap:25px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:52px;text-decoration:none;font:800 12px/1.2 var(--hf-sans);letter-spacing:.03em;padding:15px 21px}
.fv-hf__button--gold{background:var(--hf-gold);color:#10110d}.fv-hf__button--gold:hover{background:#ead0a0}
.fv-hf__text-link{font:750 13px/1.4 var(--hf-sans);color:var(--hf-ink);text-decoration-color:var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__opening-art{min-height:450px;position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(199,166,108,.27);background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,rgba(199,166,108,.13),transparent 34%),linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(17,20,20,.1),rgba(40,33,22,.38)),#101111;box-shadow:0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 96%,95% 100%,0 100%)}
.fv-hf__opening-art::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:20px;border:1px solid rgba(199,166,108,.14);pointer-events:none}
.fv-hf__opening-art-number,.fv-hf__opening-art-foot{position:absolute;color:var(--hf-gold);font:700 10px/1.65 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.16em}.fv-hf__opening-art-number{left:33px;top:35px}.fv-hf__opening-art-foot{bottom:36px;right:33px;text-align:right;color:var(--hf-muted)}
.fv-hf__opening-art-orbit{position:absolute;left:50%;top:44%;width:66%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-14deg);border:1px solid rgba(199,166,108,.47);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 21px rgba(199,166,108,.015),0 0 0 67px rgba(199,166,108,.012)}
.fv-hf__opening-art-orbit::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:13%;border:1px dashed rgba(199,166,108,.17);border-radius:50%}
.fv-hf__opening-art-cross{position:absolute;left:50%;top:42%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);color:rgba(199,166,108,.52);font:300 140px/1 var(--hf-serif)}
.fv-hf__opening-art-label{position:absolute;top:57%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;color:var(--hf-gold);font:700 10px/1.2 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.16em}.fv-hf__opening-art-line{position:absolute;top:59%;left:20%;right:20%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--hf-gold),transparent)}
.fv-hf__opening-art-seal{position:absolute;top:38%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;gap:12px;color:var(--hf-ink);font:400 clamp(70px,10vw,135px)/1 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.08em;text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(199,166,108,.24)}
.fv-hf__opening-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;padding:17px clamp(22px,7vw,125px);border-top:1px solid rgba(199,166,108,.21);font:700 10px/1.4 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--hf-muted)}.fv-hf__opening-foot a{color:var(--hf-gold);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.fv-hf__chamber{padding:clamp(90px,10vw,155px) clamp(20px,6vw,100px) clamp(80px,8vw,135px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 5% 45%,rgba(145,102,44,.09),transparent 39%),var(--hf-bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__chamber-header{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto clamp(52px,6vw,90px);text-align:center}.fv-hf__chamber-header .fv-hf__eyebrow{justify-content:center}
.fv-hf__chamber-header h2{margin:18px 0 25px;font:400 clamp(44px,6.7vw,100px)/1.03 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.05em;text-wrap:balance}.fv-hf__chamber-header h2 em{font-weight:400;color:var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__chamber-header>p:last-child{font-size:clamp(15px,1.4vw,19px);color:var(--hf-muted);max-width:730px;margin-inline:auto}
.fv-hf__records-layout{max-width:1480px;margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(235px,.37fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(25px,3vw,55px)}
.fv-hf__case-index{border-top:1px solid var(--hf-line)}.fv-hf__case-index-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font:700 10px/1.5 var(--hf-mono);color:var(--hf-gold);letter-spacing:.09em;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__case-choice-group button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr auto;align-items:start;gap:14px;text-align:left;width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line);padding:25px 14px 25px 0;background:transparent;color:var(--hf-ink);cursor:pointer}
.fv-hf__case-choice-group button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(199,166,108,.12),transparent 85%);padding-left:12px;border-left:2px solid var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__case-choice-group button:hover{color:var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__case-choice-group strong{display:block;font:400 clamp(18px,1.5vw,22px)/1.28 var(--hf-serif)}.fv-hf__case-choice-group small{display:block;margin-top:11px;color:var(--hf-muted);font:700 10px/1.35 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.08em}
.fv-hf__case-no{font:700 11px/1.4 var(--hf-mono);color:var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__index-note{padding:35px 5px;color:var(--hf-muted);font-size:14px}.fv-hf__index-dot{display:inline-block;background:var(--hf-gold);width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__index-note p{margin:12px 0 18px}.fv-hf__index-note a{color:var(--hf-gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.fv-hf__case-stage{min-width:0}.fv-hf__case-status{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.fv-hf__case{background:var(--hf-panel);border:1px solid var(--hf-line);min-width:0;box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.25);margin-bottom:25px}.fv-hf--enhanced .fv-hf__case{margin-bottom:0}
.fv-hf__case-image{height:clamp(330px,36vw,580px);position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#211a12,#1f2521);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__case-image::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.64),transparent 26%,rgba(0,0,0,.3)),radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 60%,transparent 35%,rgba(0,0,0,.31));}
.fv-hf__case-image-fallback{position:absolute;z-index:0;left:25%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font:400 clamp(20px,3vw,38px)/1.3 var(--hf-serif);color:#c4ab7a;letter-spacing:.05em}.fv-hf__case-image-fallback small{font:400 12px/1.6 var(--hf-sans)}
.fv-hf__case-image img{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%;z-index:1;filter:grayscale(.65) sepia(.24) contrast(1.05);opacity:.82}
.fv-hf__case-image--franklin img{object-fit:contain;object-position:center;background:#1b1913;opacity:.92}.fv-hf__case-image--malbone img{object-fit:contain;object-position:center;background:#171b19;filter:grayscale(.35) sepia(.38) contrast(1.08)}
.fv-hf__image-frame{position:absolute;inset:23px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid rgba(233,211,169,.27);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;padding:16px;color:#f4efe6;font:700 10px/1.4 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.09em;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000}
.fv-hf__case-body{padding:clamp(26px,3.5vw,53px)}.fv-hf__case-overline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:var(--hf-gold);font:700 10px/1.5 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.1em}.fv-hf__case-overline span:last-child{color:var(--hf-muted)}
.fv-hf__case h3{font:400 clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px)/1.08 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.046em;margin:18px 0 24px}.fv-hf__case p{color:#d5cfc3;font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,18px);line-height:1.68}.fv-hf__case-boundary{border-left:2px solid var(--hf-gold);padding:5px 0 5px 17px;margin-top:23px!important;color:var(--hf-muted)!important;font-size:14px!important}.fv-hf__case-boundary strong{color:var(--hf-ink)}
.fv-hf__case-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px 40px;margin-top:35px;border-top:1px solid var(--hf-line);padding-top:26px}
.fv-hf__case-actions details{flex:1 1 190px;max-width:100%}.fv-hf__case-actions summary{color:var(--hf-gold);cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;font-size:13px}.fv-hf__case-source{padding:20px 0 0;font-size:13px}.fv-hf__case-source p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:14px}.fv-hf__case-source a{display:block;color:var(--hf-gold);margin:10px 0;font-size:13px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fv-hf__method{padding:clamp(90px,12vw,170px) clamp(22px,7vw,125px);background:linear-gradient(140deg,#0d1110,#0c0b0a);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__method-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:var(--hf-gold);font:700 10px/1.3 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;border-top:1px solid var(--hf-line);padding-top:17px}
.fv-hf__method h2{font:400 clamp(48px,6.8vw,96px)/1.05 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.047em;max-width:1200px;margin:72px 0 100px;text-wrap:balance}.fv-hf__method h2 em{font-weight:400;color:var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__method-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--hf-line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}.fv-hf__method-grid>div{padding:30px clamp(12px,3vw,45px) 38px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--hf-line)}.fv-hf__method-grid>div+div{padding-left:clamp(17px,3vw,45px)}.fv-hf__method-grid>div:last-child{border-right:none}
.fv-hf__method-grid span{color:var(--hf-gold);font:700 10px/1.3 var(--hf-mono)}.fv-hf__method-grid h3{font:400 clamp(24px,2.4vw,36px)/1.2 var(--hf-serif);margin:29px 0 15px}.fv-hf__method-grid p{color:var(--hf-muted);font-size:15px}
.fv-hf__method>a{display:inline-block;margin-top:30px;color:var(--hf-gold);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.fv-hf__mind{position:relative;padding:clamp(95px,10vw,170px) clamp(22px,7vw,125px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,.52fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(50px,9vw,165px);align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 45%,rgba(20,77,78,.3),transparent 43%),#0a0d0d;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}
.fv-hf__mind-symbol{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-width:430px;border:1px solid rgba(199,166,108,.26);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(199,166,108,.07),transparent 65%);box-shadow:0 0 0 35px rgba(199,166,108,.012),0 0 0 82px rgba(199,166,108,.009),inset 0 0 70px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.fv-hf__mind-symbol:before,.fv-hf__mind-symbol:after{content:"";position:absolute;background:rgba(199,166,108,.38)}.fv-hf__mind-symbol:before{width:1px;height:120%;top:-10%;left:50%}.fv-hf__mind-symbol:after{height:1px;width:120%;left:-10%;top:50%}.fv-hf__mind-symbol i{position:absolute;inset:14%;border:1px dashed rgba(199,166,108,.17);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}.fv-hf__mind-symbol span{position:relative;z-index:1;color:var(--hf-gold);font:400 clamp(130px,20vw,250px)/1 var(--hf-serif);text-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(199,166,108,.3)}
.fv-hf__mind h2{font:400 clamp(46px,6vw,82px)/1.07 var(--hf-serif);letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:23px 0 24px;max-width:900px}.fv-hf__mind h2 em{font-weight:400;color:var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__mind p:not(.fv-hf__eyebrow){color:var(--hf-muted);font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,20px);max-width:680px}.fv-hf__mind-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 40px;margin:30px 0}.fv-hf__mind-actions a{font-size:14px;font-weight:740;color:var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__mind small{display:block;color:var(--hf-muted);font-size:12px}
.fv-hf__exit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr repeat(4,auto);align-items:center;gap:25px;padding:33px clamp(22px,7vw,125px);background:#151310;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hf-line)}.fv-hf__exit p{font:700 10px/1.4 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--hf-gold)}.fv-hf__exit a{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}.fv-hf__exit a:hover{color:var(--hf-gold)}
.fv-hf__footer{padding:30px clamp(22px,7vw,125px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--hf-muted);font:700 10px/1.4 var(--hf-mono);letter-spacing:.08em}.fv-hf__footer .fv-hf__brand-letter{font-family:var(--hf-sans);color:var(--hf-ink)}.fv-hf__footer a{color:var(--hf-gold);text-decoration:none}

 * JS is optional. No external resources, browser persistence, clocks, autoplay,

(() => {
  'use strict';
  const CASES = ['apollo', 'franklin', 'malbone'];

  const showImageFallback = (img) => {

    img.hidden = true; // The underlying textual fallback and original source link remain.
  };

    const status = root.querySelector('[data-fv-case-status]');
    const caseButtons = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-fv-case-button]'));
    const casePanels = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-fv-case]'));

    // Fail open on any missing or duplicate case; every case remains readable.
    if (!group || !status ||
        caseButtons.length !== CASES.length || casePanels.length !== CASES.length ||
        new Set(caseButtons.map((button) => button.dataset.fvCaseButton)).size !== CASES.length ||
        new Set(casePanels.map((panel) => panel.dataset.fvCase)).size !== CASES.length ||
        !CASES.every((id) => caseButtons.some((b) => b.dataset.fvCaseButton === id) &&
                             casePanels.some((p) => p.dataset.fvCase === id))) {
      return;
    }

    let active = CASES[0];
    let enhanced = false;
    const resetStatic = () => {
      enhanced = false;
      casePanels.forEach((panel) => { panel.hidden = false; });
      caseButtons.forEach((button) => { button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); });
      group.hidden = true;
      root.classList.remove('fv-hf--enhanced');
      status.textContent = '';
      // No inert, role="tab", focus manipulation or touch-action side effects.
    };

    const selectCase = (id, announce = true) => {
      if (!enhanced || !CASES.includes(id)) return false;
      try {
        casePanels.forEach((panel) => { panel.hidden = panel.dataset.fvCase !== id; });
        caseButtons.forEach((button) => { button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.fvCaseButton === id)); });
        active = id;
        if (announce) {
          const current = casePanels.find((panel) => panel.dataset.fvCase === id);
          const heading = current && current.querySelector('h3') && current.querySelector('h3').textContent || 'Selected record';
          status.textContent = 'Now viewing: ' + heading;
        }
        return true;
      } catch (err) {
        resetStatic();
        return false;
      }
    };

    const handleClick = (event) => {
      if (!enhanced) return;
      const button = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-fv-case-button]');
      if (button && group.contains(button)) {
        selectCase(button.dataset.fvCaseButton);
      }
    };

    const handleKeydown = (event) => {
      if (!enhanced || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
      const button = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('[data-fv-case-button]');
      if (!button || !group.contains(button)) return;
      const current = CASES.indexOf(button.dataset.fvCaseButton);
      if (current === -1) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      let next = current;
      if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (current + 1) % CASES.length;
      if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (current - 1 + CASES.length) % CASES.length;
      if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
      if (event.key === 'End') next = CASES.length - 1;
      const target = caseButtons.find((item) => item.dataset.fvCaseButton === CASES[next]);
      if (selectCase(CASES[next])) target.focus(); // Focus remains on a real button.
    };

    try {
      if (!('hidden' in document.createElement('div')) || typeof Element.prototype.closest !== 'function') {

      casePanels.forEach((panel) => { panel.hidden = panel.dataset.fvCase !== active; });

      enhanced = true;
      group.hidden = false;
      root.classList.add('fv-hf--enhanced');
      root.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
      root.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
    } catch (err) {
      resetStatic();
    }
  });

    original.hidden = false;

    tools.hidden = false;
  } catch (error) {
    restore();

(() => {

    'fv-hf-method-title', 'fv-hf-observer', 'fv-hf-mind-title'
  ];

  const nav = root.querySelector('.fv-hf__chapter-nav');
  if (!nav) return;
  const links = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]'));
  const ids = links.map((link) => link.getAttribute('href').slice(1));
  const targets = CHAPTER_IDS.map((id) => root.querySelector(`[id="${id}"]`));
  if (links.length !== CHAPTER_IDS.length ||
      ids.join('|') !== CHAPTER_IDS.join('|') || targets.some((t) => !t) ||
      new Set(targets).size !== CHAPTER_IDS.length) return;

  // Reading progress must include the whole final chapter, not just its h2.
  // The seven anchor targets remain unchanged for native fragment navigation.
  const lastHeading = targets[targets.length - 1];
  const finalChapter = (typeof lastHeading.closest === 'function' && lastHeading.closest('section')) || lastHeading;
  let running = true;
  let queued = false;
  const originalTabindex = new Map();
  // Make source chapters programmatically focusable, but not part of normal Tab order.
  targets.forEach((target) => {
    originalTabindex.set(target, target.getAttribute('tabindex'));
    if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex')) target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  });

    running = false;
    nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-enhanced');
    nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-left');
    nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-right');
    nav.style.removeProperty('--fv-trail-progress');
    links.forEach((link) => link.removeAttribute('aria-current'));
    originalTabindex.forEach((value, target) => {
      if (value === null) target.removeAttribute('tabindex');
      else target.setAttribute('tabindex', value);
    });
    window.removeEventListener('scroll', enqueue);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', enqueue);
    window.removeEventListener('hashchange', enqueue);
    nav.removeEventListener('scroll', updateOverflow);
  };
  // The nav scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports (seven full chapter labels
  // never fit); this only signals that more chapters sit off to one side so the
  // CSS can fade that edge -- scrolling itself, and every label's full text,
  // already work with no JS at all.
  const updateOverflow = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    const max = nav.scrollWidth - nav.clientWidth;
    if (max <= 1) {
      nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-left');
      nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-right');
      return;
    }
    if (nav.scrollLeft > 2) nav.setAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-left', '');
    else nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-left');
    if (nav.scrollLeft < max - 2) nav.setAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-right', '');
    else nav.removeAttribute('data-fv-trail-overflow-right');
  };
  const render = () => {
    queued = false;
    if (!running) return;
    try {
      const scroll = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
      const top = targets[0].getBoundingClientRect().top + scroll;
      const end = finalChapter.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scroll;
      const viewport = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
      const available = Math.max(1, end - top - viewport);
      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (scroll - top) / available));
      nav.style.setProperty('--fv-trail-progress', progress.toFixed(4));
      const readingLine = scroll + nav.getBoundingClientRect().height + viewport * 0.28;
      let active = 0;
      targets.forEach((target, index) => {
        if (target.getBoundingClientRect().top + scroll <= readingLine) active = index;

    window.addEventListener('hashchange', enqueue);
    nav.addEventListener('scroll', updateOverflow, { passive: true });
    enqueue();
    updateOverflow();
  } catch (_) { restore(); }
})();

        <h2 id="fv-hf-chronicle-title">One sheet of paper.<br><em>Two different worlds.</em></h2>
      </div>
      <p>The Franklin expedition left a message on an Admiralty form. A second message, written around the first, transformed what the same document could tell its readers. The contrast is in the surviving record—not an invented animation or an imagined map.</p>

        <div class="fv-hf__chronicle-entryhead"><span>01 / THE ORIGINAL NOTE</span><time datetime="1847-05-28">28 MAY 1847</time></div>
        <h3 id="fv-hf-1847-title">“All well.”</h3>
        <p>The first message, signed by Graham Gore and Charles Des Voeux, reports the expedition under Franklin's command. The words cannot describe what happened after they were written.</p>
      </article>
      <div class="fv-hf__chronicle-divider" aria-hidden="true"><span>THE MARGIN<br>CHANGES THE RECORD</span></div>

        <h3 id="fv-hf-1848-title">“Terror and Erebus were deserted”</h3>
        <p>Crozier and Fitzjames report that the ships had been abandoned on 22 April after months trapped in ice. Their marginal update records deaths and an intended journey toward Back's Fish River.</p>

      <details>
        <summary>What this evidence establishes—and what it cannot</summary>
        <div class="fv-hf__chronicle-interpretation-body">
          <p><strong>Established by the document:</strong> the expedition's earlier written status and the later account of abandonment, deaths and intended travel. These statements were recorded by expedition officers at different times.</p>
          <p><strong>Not established by the document:</strong> the final fate of every sailor after the April 1848 entry, or what every survivor experienced. The 1848 message does not erase the 1847 original—it changes our understanding of it.</p>
          <p><strong>Cataloguing note:</strong> the surviving text opens its marginal update with “25th April 1848,” while the Royal Museums Greenwich catalogue describes the addition as 26 April 1848. This exhibit uses the unambiguous month rather than silently resolving that difference.</p>

<section class="fv-hf__inquiry" id="fv-hf-inquiry" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="fv-hf-inquiry-title">
  <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-inner">
    <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-overline"><span>CHAPTER 04 / THE EVIDENCE TEST</span><span>THREE CASES · THREE LIMITS</span></div>
    <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-intro">
      <div>
        <p class="fv-hf__eyebrow">BEFORE THE CONCLUSION</p>
        <h2 id="fv-hf-inquiry-title">A source is<br><em>not a verdict.</em></h2>
      </div>
      <p>One record can be genuine and the story told about it still be wrong. Select a case, then inspect the distance between what survives, what we can reasonably infer, and what the source cannot tell us.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-rail" role="group" aria-label="Three independent source inquiries">
      <details class="fv-hf__inquiry-record" open>
        <summary><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-index" aria-hidden="true">I</span><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-question"><small>FRANKLIN EXPEDITION / 1847–1848</small><strong>How can “All well” and disaster both be in the same record?</strong></span><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary>
        <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-reveal">
          <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-folio" aria-hidden="true"><span>1847</span><i></i><span>1848</span><small>TWO ENTRIES / ONE SHEET</small></div>
          <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-analysis">
            <p class="fv-hf__inquiry-stamp">READING 01 / CHANGING EVIDENCE</p>
            <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-comparison">
              <div><h3>What survives</h3><p>Officers wrote an “All well” note in May 1847. An April 1848 addition reports that the expedition had abandoned its ships.</p></div>
              <div><h3>What remains open</h3><p>The later addition changes how the earlier message reads. It does not establish what happened to every person after that final recorded departure.</p></div>
            </div>
            <p class="fv-hf__inquiry-verdict"><span>THE BOUNDARY</span> A true statement about one moment is not a guarantee about the next.</p>
            <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-sources"><a href="https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/objects/rmgc-object-504898">Royal Museums Greenwich · Original object ↗</a><a href="https://www.historymuseum.ca/blog/a-very-special-piece-of-paper">Canadian Museum of History · Transcription ↗</a></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>

      <details class="fv-hf__inquiry-record">
        <summary><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-index" aria-hidden="true">II</span><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-question"><small>APOLLO 1 / 1967</small><strong>Can a crew portrait explain a fatal spacecraft fire?</strong></span><span class="fv-hf__inquiry-toggle" aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary>
        <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-reveal">
          <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-folio fv-hf__inquiry-folio--apollo" aria-hidden="true"><span>PHOTO</span><i></i><span>REPORT</span><small>DIFFERENT SOURCES / DIFFERENT CLAIMS</small></div>
          <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-analysis">
            <p class="fv-hf__inquiry-stamp">READING 02 / SOURCE-SPECIFIC PROOF</p>
            <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-comparison">
              <div><h3>What survives</h3><p>The NASA photograph documents the three crew members. The Apollo 204 Review Board separately reported multiple hazards, including the atmosphere, materials and inward-opening hatch.</p></div>
              <div><h3>What remains open</h3><p>The portrait does not depict the hatch mechanism or ignition event. The Review Board did not establish one definitive ignition source.</p></div>
            </div>

            <div class="fv-hf__inquiry-sources"><a href="https://www.nasa.gov/image-detail/apollo-1-crew-honored/">NASA · Crew photograph ↗</a><a href="https://www.nasa.gov/missions/apollo/apollo-1/report-of-the-apollo-204-review-board/">NASA · Apollo 204 Review Board ↗</a></div>
